conbody.p: The game world configurations exist in two directories - ServerFolder/Data and ServerFolder/GameServer/Data.
In your game world, you can configure:

ul.li: Invasions and events: Rate, amount, rewards
Items: Stats, drop rate, drop groups
Characters: Stats, skills, PvP balance, experience rate

conbody.p: This section guides you through how the configurations work and how to change them.
